tavily_results.content:
Paul and James printed our first custom titanium implant, but it was still early days for the business. As a team of just two engineers, only 5-6 implants were produced a year for patients in New Zealand.

When the Christchurch earthquakes tore through our original premises, it was make or break time for the company. Gathering all the materials that could be saved, a new office was found. Relaunching under the name OSSIS marked the start of a new era of implant technology.
